items.user_turn: I've been meaning to bring up some side effects of my current medication. Since I started taking lisinopril about three weeks ago, I've noticed mild lightheadedness, especially when I stand up quickly. It's been happening mostly in the mornings and I’d rate the episodes a 4 out of 10 in severity. I missed a couple of doses last month, too, which I wonder might have impacted how I feel. Also, I've been experiencing mild nausea after taking melatonin. I could use some clarity on these effects.
